# wayfinder_workspace_nodepool (Resource)

Nodepool is the schema for cluster nodepool definitions in Wayfinder

<a id="nestedblock--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `image` (String) Image is the image we should use on the instances of this pool
- `machine` (String) Machine is the instance type of the nodes in the poll
- `name` (String) Name is the name of the nodepool
- `size` (Number) Size is initial size if autoscaling defined - or the effective size if no autoscaling is enabled

Optional:

- `autoscaling` (Block List, Max: 1) Autocaling indicates the node pool should autoscale (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--autoscaling))
- `description` (String) Description provides an optional description to the node pool
- `disk_size` (Number) DiskSize is the amount of disk space to assign to the nodes in MBs
- `expires` (String) Expires provides a time for automatic expiration of the cluster
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels is a collection of label placed on to the nodepool
- `max_pods_per_node` (Number) MaxPodsPerNode controls how many pods can be scheduled onto each node in this pool
- `provider_details` (Block List, Max: 1) ProviderDetails provides any cloud specific options for this nodepool (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details))
- `spot` (Block List, Max: 1) Spot if defines enables nodepool to use spot instances (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--spot))
- `taints` (Block List) Taints defines a collection scheduling taints placed on the nodepool (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--taints))
- `version` (String) Version is the initial version of kubernetes on the node pool
- `zones` (List of String) Zones defines a list of cloud specific availability zones where the nodes are permitted to run

<a id="nestedblock--spec--autoscaling"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.autoscaling`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled indicates the node pool to use autoscaling
- `max_size` (Number) MaxSize is the maximum number of nodes if autoscaling is enabled
- `min_size` (Number) MinSize is minimum number of nodes if autoscaling is enabled


<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details`

Required:

- `type` (String)

Optional:

- `aks` (Block List, Max: 1) AKS defines the cloud specific options for AKS clusters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aks))
- `eks` (Block List, Max: 1) EKS defines a cloud specific options for EKS clusters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details--eks))
- `gke` (Block List, Max: 1) GKE is the provider specification for their clusters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details--gke))
- `unmanaged` (Block List, Max: 1) Unmanaged provides the specification for unmanaged cluster (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--spec--provider_details--unmanaged))

<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--aks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.aks`

Optional:

- `mode` (String) Mode is the type of the node pool. System node pools serve the primary purpose of hosting critical system pods such as CoreDNS and tunnelfront. User node pools serve the primary purpose of hosting your application pods.


<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--eks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.eks`

Optional:

- `e_c_2_ssh_key` (String) EC2SSHKey is the Amazon EC2 SSH key that provides access for SSH communication with the worker nodes in the managed node group https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ec2-key-pairs.html
- `ssh_source_security_groups` (List of String) SSHSourceSecurityGroups is the security groups that are allowed SSH access (port 22) to the worker nodes


<a id="nestedblock--spec--provider_details--gke"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.provider_details.gke`

Optional:

- `enable_autorepair` (Boolean) EnableAutorepair indicates if the node pool should automatically repair failed nodes
- `enable_autoupgrade` (Boolean) EnableAutoUpgrade indicates if the node group should be configured with auto-upgrading enabled. This must be true if the cluster has ReleaseChannel set.
